## About
Finest Auto Body and Paint is a family owned and operated body shop on Irvington Blvd in Houston. We fix collision damage, straighten frames, repair dents and hail damage, and match paint so the repair blends in with the rest of your car.
Whether it's a personal job or an insurance claim, we'll work with your insurance company and keep you in the loop until your car is back in pre-accident condition. We specialize in European cars, and all makes are welcome.
We're a member of HABA, the Houston Auto Body Association, and we back our collision repairs with a lifetime warranty.

## Services
- Collision and frame repair: Body, frame and paint repairs after any kind of accident, aiming to return your car to pre-accident condition.
- Paint color matching: Our trained paint technicians use a computerized color matching and mixing system to match the original color.
- Dent removal and hail damage repair: From door dings to hail damage, we work out dents and restore the finish.
- Auto glass and detailing: Glass work and detailing to finish the job inside and out.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work with insurance companies?
A: Yes. We handle both personal and insurance jobs, and we'll work with your insurance company to get your car back on the road.

Q: Do you give free estimates?
A: Yes. Call us to schedule a time and we'll take a look at your car.

Q: Do you work on European cars?
A: We specialize in European cars, and all makes are welcome.
